The VTES printing of a bunch of clan hosers (like Malk Dementia, Brujah
Frenzy, and Gangrel De-evolution) were misprinted with the "You need this
clan" symbol on them. They are mis prints, and wrong. You do not need a
Malkavian to play Malkavian Dementia, or a Gangrel to play Gangrel Atavism
(as I think it is now called).

It doesn't make much sense to need a member of clan X to hose clan X.
